description: The plot illustrates the relationship between model variants and performance metrics. The x-axis is labeled “Model Variants” and displays categorical values: “Full model (ours)”, “w/o Prompt”, “w/o Augmentation”, “w/o Attention”, and “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The y-axis is labeled “Metric (%)” with a linear scale ranging from 58 to 66, with tick labels at intervals of 2. The first line, colored blue and marked with circular data points, represents “Precision”, starting at 65.78 at “Full model (ours)” and decreasing to 57.74 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The second line, colored orange and marked with square data points, represents “Recall”, beginning at 65.44 at “Full model (ours)” and ending at 56.82 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”. The third line, colored purple and marked with triangular data points, represents “F1-score”, starting at 64.06 at “Full model (ours)”, decreasing to 60.16 at “w/o Prompt”, increasing to 62.63 at “w/o Augmentation”, decreasing to 59.67 at “w/o Attention”, and finally decreasing to 59.17 at “w/o Prompt & Augmentation”.
